name: section-hero
title: Hero Section
description: Hero section in four layouts (split, centered, image, type) that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: Text and image side by side from md, stacked on a phone; the default with an image.
layouts.usage: <HeroSection layout="split" content={{ title, lead, ctas, image }} />

layouts.title: Centred
layouts.description: Text centred in one column, the image (if any) below it; the default without an image.

layouts.title: Image
layouts.description: The image fills the section and the text sits on a panel over it.
layouts.usage: <HeroSection layout="image" content={{ title, lead, ctas, image }} />

layouts.title: Type
layouts.description: Large type, with the lead, a short list and the calls to action beside a rule; no image.
layouts.usage: <HeroSection layout="type" content={{ title, lead, points, ctas }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; four layouts; default look equals 2.0.0; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no colour, font or radius leak
postMessage: See components/section-hero/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
